scope: EQ situational-judgment instrument, keyed ordinal scoring, interpretation and runtime response boundary
construct: emotional and social response capability as operationalized by ReadyScore EQ
intended_use: self-exploration of relative response patterns across four EQ dimensions; not diagnosis or standardized psychometric EQ norm
dimension_score: weighted mean keyed ordinal normalized from [1,4] to [0,100]
overall: arithmetic mean of four dimension scores when all 24 responses are present
historical_boundary: EQ V1 question versions remain immutable; V2 uses new logical question identities and active taxonomy boundary.
content_status: Product SJT candidates; keyed scoring is a product measurement rule and is not presented as psychometrically validated.
